quote.text: The husbandman deals with land; physicians and trainers with the body; the wise man with his own Mind.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Just as a husbandman tends to his land, a parent must cultivate the fertile ground of a child's mind with care, nurturing qualities that will yield a lifetime of growth and resilience.
    • By focusing on developing both wisdom and character in themselves, parents set an example; they create an environment where children learn the art of self-cultivation and personal responsibility.
  • Leadership
    • A leader, much like a physician or trainer, understands that guiding others starts with self-mastery; honing one's own mind is essential before inspiring and directing a team.
    • Effective leadership comes not only from strategy and external actions but also from continuous inner reflection, ensuring that decisions and values are aligned with true wisdom and integrity.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, as in the disciplines of care and development, the focus on one’s own mind is key—cultivating clarity of vision and creative problem solving enables one to nurture and refine a product.
    • Much like dealing with the body or land, the product manager must be attuned to both the technical and strategic aspects, making deliberate choices that ensure long-term success and adaptation.
